title: Register machines (FR-1)
body:
**User story:** As a planner I register equipment so readings can be attached to it.

**Owner agent:** backend
**Spec:** FR-1; openapi: /api/machines

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a unique code, name and type, when I POST /api/machines then I get 201 and it appears in GET /api/machines
- [ ] Given a duplicate code then 409
- [ ] Given an invalid code, type or empty name then 422 with the failing field

## Verification
backend/tests/integration/test_journey_and_persistence.py

title: Record and score a sensor reading (FR-2, FR-3)
body:
**User story:** As an operator I record readings and see a risk level immediately.

**Owner agent:** backend
**Spec:** FR-2, FR-3; openapi: /api/readings

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given a registered machine, when I POST a valid reading then 201 with risk score 0-100, level and X-Trace-Id header
- [ ] Unknown machine gives 404; invalid or out-of-range values give 422
- [ ] v1 boundaries 40/70/85 are covered; v2 adds an outlier bonus and never exceeds 100

## Verification
backend/tests/unit/test_risk.py, test_validation.py, integration tests

title: Automatic work orders without duplicates (FR-4)
body:
**User story:** As a planner I want a work order when a machine degrades.

**Owner agent:** backend
**Spec:** FR-4

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] high -> P2, critical -> P1 work order, status open
- [ ] A machine with a non-done work order does not get a duplicate
- [ ] auto_work_orders=false disables creation

## Verification
test_critical_reading_opens_one_p1_work_order_and_dedupes, test_auto_work_orders_can_be_disabled

title: Work-order workflow (FR-5)
body:
**User story:** As a technician I progress and close work orders.

**Owner agent:** backend
**Spec:** FR-5; openapi: /api/work-orders

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] open -> in_progress -> done; done is final (409)
- [ ] Unknown status or fields give 422; unknown id gives 404
- [ ] Assignee can be set

## Verification
test_work_order_lifecycle_and_invalid_transitions

title: Dashboard and persistence (FR-6, FR-7)
body:
**User story:** As a planner I see fleet risk at a glance and my data survives restarts.

**Owner agent:** frontend
**Spec:** FR-6, FR-7

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dashboard shows totals, per-level counts, open work orders, readings in 24 h and active model
- [ ] Machines table shows latest risk; forms register machines and record readings with instant validation
- [ ] Data persists across app instances (database, not memory)

## Verification
test_data_persists_across_app_instances, frontend/tests

title: OpenAPI contract and contract test (NFR-1)
body:
**User story:** As a team we want the contract to be the source of truth.

**Owner agent:** architect
**Spec:** NFR-1

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every route is in openapi.yaml and every documented route exists
- [ ] Real responses (including error statuses) validate against the schemas

## Verification
backend/tests/integration/test_openapi_contract.py

title: Runtime config with history and rollback (FR-8)
body:
**User story:** As an operator I change config safely and can undo it.

**Owner agent:** backend
**Spec:** FR-8, NFR-7

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Invalid values are rejected (422) unless fault injection is enabled
- [ ] Every change is recorded with actor and verified flag
- [ ] Rollback restores the latest verified-good value; 409 when none exists
- [ ] Admin endpoints require a bearer token

## Verification
test_admin_and_incident_primitives.py

title: Full-stack tests with a single command (NFR-5)
body:
**User story:** As a reviewer I run all tests with one command.

**Owner agent:** qa
**Spec:** NFR-5

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] make test runs unit, integration, on-call and frontend tests
- [ ] Unit and integration are separated by pytest markers
- [ ] Integration suite also runs on PostgreSQL in CI

## Verification
Makefile, pytest.ini, ci.yml

title: Containerise the whole system (NFR-5)
body:
**User story:** As a developer I start everything with one command.

**Owner agent:** devops
**Spec:** NFR-5

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] docker compose up --build starts db, app, alerter, responder
- [ ] App waits for a healthy database
- [ ] Smoke test passes against the compose stack

## Verification
Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, ci.yml containers job

title: CI on every PR; CD to dev; manual prod deploy (NFR-6)
body:
**User story:** As a team we ship safely.

**Owner agent:** devops
**Spec:** NFR-6

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CI runs on every pull request
- [ ] Merge to main deploys to dev automatically after CI and smoke-tests it
- [ ] Production deploy is manual, needs approval and can deploy an older ref (rollback)

## Verification
.github/workflows

title: Deploy to a public URL
body:
**User story:** As a reviewer I can open the running app.

**Owner agent:** devops
**Spec:** NFR-6

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dev environment is reachable at a public URL listed in the README
- [ ] scripts/smoke_test.py passes against it

## Verification
docs/deployment.md

title: Instrument the key journey (NFR-2)
body:
**User story:** As an engineer I can follow one reading through the system.

**Owner agent:** observability
**Spec:** NFR-2

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Metrics, spans and structured logs share one trace ID
- [ ] Responses carry X-Trace-Id and W3C traceparent; incoming traceparent is continued
- [ ] Signals are stored and viewable at /observability and /metrics
- [ ] No credentials or customer data are stored in telemetry

## Verification
test_observability.py, test_telemetry.py

title: Alert on user impact (NFR-3)
body:
**User story:** As on-call I am paged on user impact, not CPU.

**Owner agent:** observability
**Spec:** NFR-3

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Alert rules use the journey error ratio and p95 latency
- [ ] Low traffic does not page; a firing alert is not duplicated

## Verification
ops/alerts/alert-rules.yaml, oncall/tests

title: On-call agent fixes a bad config push (NFR-4)
body:
**User story:** As on-call I want the system to recover without waking me.

**Owner agent:** oncall
**Spec:** NFR-4

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On alert the agent diagnoses from traces and config history
- [ ] It rolls back to the last verified-good config, verifies with 3 canary readings, resolves the alert and records an incident
- [ ] Unknown causes and latency alerts are escalated without any write
- [ ] Only config_rollback is permitted; dry-run mode exists

## Verification
oncall/tests/test_oncall_e2e.py, scripts/simulate_incident.py

title: Security hardening (NFR-7)
body:
**User story:** As an owner I do not ship insecure defaults.

**Owner agent:** devops
**Spec:** NFR-7

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Production refuses to start with the default admin token
- [ ] Fault injection is off by default in production (403)
- [ ] UI uses textContent only; SQL is parameterised

## Verification
test_db.py, test_admin_and_incident_primitives.py
